description: This file defines the UserSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate filtering parameters when searching for users within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as status, username, user role ID, employee number, and password presence, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: UserSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for specifying filter parameters in user search operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status filter (boolean or null).

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username filter as a string or null.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Returns the user role ID filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: hasPassword
methods.description: Returns whether to filter by presence of password (boolean or null).

methods.name: setHasPassword
methods.description: Sets the password presence filter parameter.
